outcome: time to initiation of rescue insulin
factors influencing choice of GDM pharmacotherapy
cohort: The cohort included 5633 pregnancies from 5393 women with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) without prior diabetes history who received a GDM diagnosis or initiated an antidiabetic drug after 20 weeks gestation, studied between 1998 and 2017.
finding: Metformin became the most prescribed medication for GDM in the United Kingdom, with its use as first-line treatment increasing substantially from less than 5% before 2007 to over 85% in 2015.
gest_age: Antidiabetic drug initiation after 20 weeks gestation
